QUESTION: Analyze the company's Tax related liabilities and comment on it.

Structure your answer as:
## Summary
3–5 bullet points with the key conclusions.
## Key figures
A table with columns: Item | Current year | Prior year | Change | % change | Source.
## Detailed analysis
Trends, drivers, ratios and interpretation relevant to the question.
## Impact on the financial statements
How the matters in the notes flow into and affect each primary statement. Use one sub-heading per statement:
### Statement of Profit and Loss
### Balance Sheet
### Cash Flow Statement
### Statement of Changes in Equity
For each one, name the line items affected, give their figures (current and prior year, citing statement and page), show how the note reconciles to them, and explain the effect. For example, how the tax expense in the note drives profit after tax, how deferred tax balances appear on the Balance Sheet, how taxes paid appear in operating cash flow, or how OCI items move reserves in equity.
## Red flags & areas for follow-up
Anything unusual, inconsistent, or worth asking management about, including any note figure that does not agree with the statements.
## Sources
The notes, statements and PDF pages you relied on.

The major components of income tax expense/(income) recognised for the year ended March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025 are:
Statement of profit and loss:
Profit or loss section
In ₹Million
Particulars | Year ended | Year ended

(a) The Group offsets tax assets and liabilities if and only if it has a legally enforceable right to set off current tax assets and
current tax liabilities and the deferred tax assets and deferred tax liabilities relate to income taxes levied by the same tax
authority.
(b) The Group has tax losses which arose due to carried forward business losses in India ₹4,398.53 million (March 31, 2025:
₹4,336.78 million) that are available for offsetting for eight years against future taxable profits of the Group under the
head income from business. This loss will expire in eight years from the end of the respective year to which it pertains.
(c) The Group has tax losses which arose due to carried forward business losses in the USA of ₹2,718.53 million (March 31,
2025: ₹2,457.95 million) that are available for offsetting for twenty years and ₹8,000.24 million (March 31, 2025:
₹7,622.66 million) that are available for offsetting indefinitely against future taxable profits under relevant heads of income
of the companies in which the losses arose. These losses will expire in various years between tax years 2026 and 2037.
(d) The Group has tax losses which arose due to carried forward business losses in Sweden of ₹353.13 million (March 31,
2025: ₹2,715.96 million) that are available for offsetting for an indefinite period against future taxable profits under
relevant heads of income of the subsidiary in which the losses arose. Also the Group has tax losses which arose due to
carried forward business losses in Germany of ₹13,929.32 million (March 31, 2025: ₹9.698.51 million) that are available
for offsetting for an indefinite period against future taxable profits under relevant heads of income of the subsidiaries in
which the losses arose.
(e) During the years ended March 31, 2026 and March 31, 2025, the group entities incorporated in India have not surrendered
any transaction or disclosed as income in the tax assessments under the Income Tax Act, 1961, (such as, search or survey
or any other relevant provisions of the Income Tax Act, 1961).
